name: Birthday
overview: Scripture references birthdays as occasions marked by feasts, as seen in Pharaoh's celebration in Genesis 40:20. While the Bible does not explicitly command celebrating birthdays, it emphasizes the importance of recognizing God's blessings and the passing of time, encouraging believers to seek wisdom and delight in the Lord (Psalms 37:4; Psalms 90:12). God's goodness crowns the year of our lives, and His blessings are central to the desires of our hearts, reminding us to honor Him in all seasons of life (Psalms 65:11; Psalms 20:4; Numbers 6:24).
